intent: Specify the Montgomery-arithmetic helpers of `p3_monty_31::utils` (crate `p3-monty-31`): `to_monty`, `to_monty_64`, `from_monty`, `monty_reduce`, `large_monty_reduce`, `monty_reduce_u128`, `add` and `sub`, for the BabyBear and KoalaBear parameter sets. They are generic over `MP: MontyParameters`; in Lean the trait instance is an explicit argument, e.g. `utils.monty_reduce inst x`. Instantiate them with the ready-made instances of the module `Benchmark.V2.Plonky3.Monty31Utils.Params` (already imported by the template): `RSGB.Monty31.BB : data_traits.MontyParameters Unit` (BabyBear: `PRIME = 0x78000001`, `MONTY_BITS = 32`, `MONTY_MU = 0x88000001`, `MONTY_MASK = 0xffffffff`) and `RSGB.Monty31.KB` (KoalaBear: `PRIME = 0x7f000001`, `MONTY_BITS = 32`, `MONTY_MU = 0x81000001`, `MONTY_MASK = 0xffffffff`), e.g. `utils.add RSGB.Monty31.BB a b`.

manual_mutants.note: high limb truncated to 16 bits: correct for every x < 2^80 (in particular on all u64 inputs)
high limb not converted (hi instead of hi*R mod P): agrees with monty_reduce on every u64 input
pre-reduction dropped: result is still congruent to x/R but can be >= P for x in [R*P, 2*R*P)
missing +P correction after a borrow (result off by P when x < t*P)
reduction only when the sum exceeds P: a + b = P returns P instead of 0
equal operands return P instead of 0 (non-canonical zero)
input truncated to 32 bits: still agrees with to_monty on every u32
pre-reduction subtracts P*2^31 instead of P*2^32 (congruent, but outputs leave [0, P) near 2RP)

sibling_mutants.note: wrapping sum: identical on the documented domain a + b <= 2P, no overflow panic outside it
outside the documented domain x < R*P the (unspecified) result is clamped to 0
sibling_mutants.after: (do let r ← core.num.U32.wrapping_add x_sub_u_hi corr; ok (if r < i5 then r else 0#u32))

sibling_mutants.note: pre-reduction by x mod R*P: identical on [0, 2RP), different (correct) results above

historical implementation before Plonky3 #1483 (a172a19a): x * R^-1 mod P via one u128 multiplication and %; same results on the documented domain x < 2^96, no debug_assert (and no panic for x >= 2^96 as long as x * R^-1 fits u128)

edits.with_text:
def utils.monty_reduce_u128
  {MP : Type} (data_traitsMontyParametersInst : data_traits.MontyParameters MP)
  (x : Std.U128) :
  RustM Std.U32
  := do
  let i ← data_traitsMontyParametersInst.PRIME
  let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 i)
  let i2 ← data_traitsMontyParametersInst.MONTY_MU
  let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 i2)
  let i4 ← i1 * i3
  let i5 ← i4 - 1#u64
  let i6 ← data_traitsMontyParametersInst.MONTY_BITS
  let i7 ← i5 >>> i6
  let monty_inv_mod_p ← i - (UScalar.cast .U32 i7)
  let i8 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 monty_inv_mod_p)
  let i9 ← x * i8
  let i10 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 i)
  let i11 ← i9 % i10
  ok (UScalar.cast .U32 i11)

bug_variants.note: monty_reduce_u128 combines the two reduced limbs with a plain (checked) u32 addition instead of the modular add: the sum is congruent to x * R^-1 but lies in [0, 2P), breaking the documented output range [0, P) (and disagreeing with monty_reduce on most u64 inputs is avoided only because hi = 0 there). No historical bug fix touches these helpers (history of monty-31/src/utils.rs and baby-bear/src/baby_bear.rs up to 6468485f: only refactors/speedups).
